name: infocutter
description: Manifest V3 DOM-hiding Chrome extension for managing per-site selectors.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/build.mjs
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean:all && npm run build && npm run doctor
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.rc: npm run rebuild && npm run check && npm run build:zip
